title: Wife, children and family
summary: Home in Thibodeaux, six children, 24 grandchildren; daughter plays piano, son saxophone.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: So, she's got our home out there too, you know. And that's our home. Of course she's been dead not going on.
How many children do you have? I have six.
Are many other musicians of the children, any of those?
Well, we have my oldest daughter. She learned how to play piano a little bit. And I got my son. He plays saxophone. And that's one of the twins. I take them to California.
Is that a picture of a band up there? Oh, yes. A picture on the wall. Oh, in the army. Your father.
No, that's my son. That's one came in there.
Oh, yes. The one we just, the son just came in. I mean, that's the army over there.
